title: Pesto Chicken Salad with Sun-Dried Tomatoes
changes_from_base: A quick basil pesto replaces the soured cream and herbs, and sun-dried tomatoes replace the celery and spring onion.
summary: Poached chicken folded through a quick basil pesto mayonnaise with chopped sun-dried tomatoes: an easy sandwich or lunchbox filling.
equipment: small food processor or pestle and mortar

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt
oil-packed sun-dried tomatoes, blotted and chopped

steps.title: Cook the chicken gently
steps.text: Bring the chicken and a bay leaf, barely covered in cold water, slowly to a gentle simmer. Cover the pan, switch off the heat and let it stand until a thermometer reads 74 °C, about a quarter of an hour. Cool, then tear into strips.

steps.title: Make the pesto
steps.text: Blitz or pound the basil, pine nuts, cheese and garlic, then work in the oil to a coarse paste.

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Stir the pesto with the mayonnaise, lemon, salt and pepper, then fold in the chicken and sun-dried tomatoes.

steps.title: Chill
steps.text: Chill 20 min. Serve on toasted bread, on lettuce leaves or with crackers.

tips: Blot the sun-dried tomatoes well so the salad is not oily.
Shred the chicken by hand for the best texture.
Add a squeeze of lemon if serving the next day.
storage: Keeps covered in the fridge for up to 2 days. Not suitable for freezing. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
